highlights.title: Protecting Earth’s fragile biodiversity takes spotlight at Armenia talks
highlights.summary: Biodiversity losses continue to upend the lives of billions of people whose future prosperity depends on countries taking urgent action to protect our planet, the top UN official leading talks at the UN Biodiversity Conference in Yerevan, said on Monday.

highlights.title: Italian PM Meloni to hold emergency meeting after weekend of violent clashes
highlights.summary: More than 200 people were detained during two days of rioting in the city, Italian media reports.
